title: Great local tour guides
text: Our tour guide Andy was terrific!  Very funny and knowledgeable.  He went out of his ways to help us find a nice restaurant after the trip and even ordered lunch for us.
author: G4727MEjustinel

title: Absolutely fabulous tour...
text:
Absolutely fabulous tour to Montserrat! An unforgettable experience from beginning to end. 
🔥🔥🔥A special shout-out to our amazing guides, Paolina and Merac! ❤️ They were absolutely fantastic — so friendly, knowledgeable, enthusiastic and full of positive energy. They made everyone feel welcome, shared interesting stories and made the whole experience fun and memorable. Their passion and professionalism really made the difference. We couldn't have asked for better guides! Thank you both for such a wonderful day! 🌟
author: Tatev_H

title: half day tour
text: Easy to find location of meet. Guides were very friendly and welcomed our sign language interpreters from ship at no cost. It showed us they know it was necessary for us to have access to communication for tour. THANK YOU to the guides for allowing us bring our interpreters. Bus ride to and from was very comfortable. Weather was perfect and we were able to see everything from top.
author: KevStace

title: Orio and MK were the best tour guides. Funny, knowledgeable and professional.  Super friendly and patient
text: It was amazing, I am impressed witht the area, it was a good experience. Unfortunately I could not take pic as my phone was broken.  But maybe is a reason to come back

title: Great Experience, highly recommend.
text: Very good 1/2 day experience. MK is an excellent guide. Very much appreciate the history of the area and Montserrat. Plenty of time at Montserrat. Recommend this tour for those who want to explore outside of Barcelona.
